requirement: All four recovery transports are received, hash-verified and read before mutation
positive_proof: Exact filenames and SHA-256 values match the delivery register
negative_or_hostile_proof: Missing or altered transport fails intake closed

requirement: Every closure claim identifies one full exact tested SHA
positive_proof: Manifest, runtime, CI and evidence record the same 40-character SHA
negative_or_hostile_proof: Missing, shortened, alias or different SHA fails closure

requirement: Every catalogue row maps to implementation, tests and evidence
positive_proof: Machine-readable traceability validates all 50 unique IDs
negative_or_hostile_proof: Missing, duplicate or manually overridden row fails audit

requirement: Distinct journeys have distinct action traces and evidence
positive_proof: Required captures and traces exist with purpose-specific hashes
negative_or_hostile_proof: Duplicate screenshots or generic observations fail

requirement: CI retains exact-SHA browser evidence and closure attestation
positive_proof: Downloadable artifacts contain manifest, traces, logs and checksums
negative_or_hostile_proof: Absent or unverifiable artifacts fail closure

requirement: Ordinary acceptance is separated from QA diagnostics
positive_proof: Every test is classified and ordinary gates use ordinary interaction
negative_or_hostile_proof: Force hooks or direct state mutation cannot satisfy ordinary gates

requirement: Customer journey starts at root and Play enters the game
positive_proof: Real browser follows / to Play to splash to Phaser Main Menu
negative_or_hostile_proof: Direct /play navigation alone cannot pass

requirement: Approved splash image is visible for two seconds
positive_proof: Clock-bounded assertion proves image and duration
negative_or_hostile_proof: Missing image, premature dismissal and excessive duration fail

requirement: Splash displays exact approved copyright and collaborator copy
positive_proof: Rendered text matches the governed string exactly
negative_or_hostile_proof: Misspelling, omission or unapproved substitution fails

requirement: Keyboard focus returns to a usable Main Menu action
positive_proof: Focused element is visible and operable after splash
negative_or_hostile_proof: Lost, hidden or body-only focus fails

requirement: Splash does not replay during ordinary internal navigation
positive_proof: Navigate away and back without another splash
negative_or_hostile_proof: New independent game entry remains capable of showing splash

requirement: Pause freezes the complete simulation
positive_proof: Entity positions, timers, hazards and score remain unchanged while paused
negative_or_hostile_proof: Background simulation or input mutation during pause fails

requirement: Pause provides Resume, Restart and Main Menu for keyboard, touch and controller
positive_proof: Each input route performs the selected action exactly once
negative_or_hostile_proof: Hidden, duplicate or unintended action fails

requirement: Results information is readable above and unobscured by the panel
positive_proof: Visual and DOM/canvas assertions prove all governed result values
negative_or_hostile_proof: Overlap, clipping or absent values fail

requirement: Continue exists only when the pinned release has a next entry
positive_proof: Six- and seven-level releases resolve ordered next entries
negative_or_hostile_proof: No-next, gap or duplicate sequence must not offer Continue

requirement: Scores, lives and nukes persist correctly through campaign transitions
positive_proof: Ordinary play transition retains governed cumulative state
negative_or_hostile_proof: Restart, abort or new campaign cannot leak invalid state

requirement: Recurring asteroids and comets are visible and governed in ordinary play
positive_proof: Normal play proves varied direction, speed, collision, destruction and despawn
negative_or_hostile_proof: Invisible bodies, max-active breach or QA-only targeting fails

requirement: Levels 1 through 6 are independently configured and playable
positive_proof: Each level loads its pinned checksum and completes by ordinary input
negative_or_hostile_proof: Missing, duplicated fallback or hard-coded seed use fails

requirement: Final campaign victory occurs only after the last pinned release entry
positive_proof: Ordinary completion of final entry renders victory without Continue
negative_or_hostile_proof: Premature victory or post-final Continue fails

requirement: All existing CORE Levels 1 through 6 open directly in the product Designer
positive_proof: Authorised admin can inspect complete draft, published and release identity
negative_or_hostile_proof: Customer, anonymous or cross-owner access fails server-side

requirement: Pointer mapping is accurate at 50, 75, 100, 125 and 150 percent zoom
positive_proof: Real pointer drag from centre and edges saves expected canonical coordinates
negative_or_hostile_proof: Wrapper coordinates, pointer loss and out-of-bounds values fail

requirement: Mouse, pen and touch dragging uses pointer capture and preserves grab offset
positive_proof: Real browser input leaves/re-enters playfield and completes one transaction
negative_or_hostile_proof: Mouse-only handlers, centre jump or multiple undo entries fail

requirement: Animated assets use one canonical representative preview frame
positive_proof: Palette, layers and inspector show governed frame and aspect ratio
negative_or_hostile_proof: Full sprite-sheet thumbnails or unexplained UI crop constants fail

requirement: Level metadata, canvas, grid, background, seed and player spawn are editable
positive_proof: Save, reload and preview prove typed values persist and execute
negative_or_hostile_proof: Invalid bounds, duplicate enabled spawn and immutable-field edits fail

requirement: Entities and mixed formations expose complete governed configuration
positive_proof: Membership, layout, bounds, spacing, motion, timing and repeat round-trip
negative_or_hostile_proof: Invalid member, unsafe profile, overlap rule or missing field fails validation

requirement: Hazards, placed hazards, shields and destructible matrices are fully editable
positive_proof: Every runtime field round-trips and changes exact-checksum preview
negative_or_hostile_proof: Invalid ranges, missing assets or budget overflow fail

requirement: Drops, objectives, Boarding anchors, gameplay, scoring and budgets are editable
positive_proof: Every Level 1-6 differing value has a usable typed control or governed exception
negative_or_hostile_proof: Source-only, seed-only or UI-shadow configuration fails

requirement: Draft save is immutable, refresh-safe and checksum-addressable
positive_proof: Material edits save a new version and survive full refresh/relogin
negative_or_hostile_proof: In-place historical mutation, stale checksum or lost edit fails

requirement: Exact-checksum preview uses the same configuration authority as runtime
positive_proof: Moved object, formation, composition and hazard changes appear in preview
negative_or_hostile_proof: Seed fallback, source constant or checksum mismatch fails

requirement: Only authorised internal administrators publish CORE content
positive_proof: Authorised publication creates immutable version and audit record
negative_or_hostile_proof: Anonymous, customer and organisation attempts fail server-side

requirement: Published Designer changes appear in a newly started ordinary campaign
positive_proof: New campaign resolves new release and visibly plays all material changes
negative_or_hostile_proof: Old seed, cached release or hard-coded runtime fallback fails

requirement: Existing active campaigns remain pinned to their original release
positive_proof: Campaign created before publication continues on old checksums
negative_or_hostile_proof: Silent mutation to the new release fails

requirement: Rollback publishes a new version derived from selected history
positive_proof: Restored baseline appears in a new campaign with complete audit lineage
negative_or_hostile_proof: Destructive rewrite or deletion of history fails

requirement: Campaign publication accepts ordered gap-free campaigns of six or more entries
positive_proof: Six- and seven-level publications succeed and Continue follows pinned order
negative_or_hostile_proof: Gaps, duplicate/non-positive sequence or unpublished entry fails

requirement: Administration identifies current draft, published version and containing release
positive_proof: Every Level 1-6 view exposes unambiguous identities and preview status
negative_or_hostile_proof: Ambiguous, stale or ranked-preview labelling fails

requirement: Board and Continue are distinct governed actions
positive_proof: Board enters interior; Continue resumes Shooter/campaign according to state
negative_or_hostile_proof: Either action entering the wrong scene or loop fails

requirement: A visible entry airlock begins a physical interior journey
positive_proof: Ordinary input enters at the governed entry and traverses away from it
negative_or_hostile_proof: Teleport-only entry, missing airlock or incorrect anchor fails

requirement: Platform combat includes movement, jump, fire, enemies, health and collisions
positive_proof: Ordinary input demonstrates patrol/engage, projectiles, hits and elimination
negative_or_hostile_proof: Static enemies, non-colliding shots or invulnerable states fail

requirement: Player and alien governed animation states are visible
positive_proof: Idle, move, jump/fall, fire, hit and death states use admitted metadata
negative_or_hostile_proof: Static crop, unexplained frame constants or missing required state fails

requirement: Visible far exit succeeds only after the interior objective
positive_proof: Physical arrival after completion synchronises position then completes server-side
negative_or_hostile_proof: Early exit, stale-position rejection or hidden completion fails

requirement: Pause and ESC present Resume, confirmed Abort and authorised Main Menu
positive_proof: Resume continues; confirmed abort returns to exact Shooter checkpoint
negative_or_hostile_proof: Immediate abort, loop, duplicate offer or state loss fails

requirement: Success, death and API failure have safe deterministic outcomes
positive_proof: Each path preserves or changes campaign resources according to contract
negative_or_hostile_proof: Double completion, stuck session or ungoverned fallback fails

requirement: Admin, Command Post and player surfaces enforce server-side roles and ownership
positive_proof: Authorised role succeeds only for owned scope
negative_or_hostile_proof: Anonymous, wrong-role and cross-organisation access fails

requirement: Login redirects use one same-origin internal-path validator
positive_proof: Valid internal next succeeds
negative_or_hostile_proof: External, protocol-relative, backslash, encoded and active-protocol forms fail

requirement: Player account provides visible CSRF-protected logout
positive_proof: Logout clears session and returns to public route
negative_or_hostile_proof: Missing/invalid CSRF and post-logout API access fail

requirement: Django Admin remains diagnostic and is not the product authoring authority
positive_proof: Product administration performs all governed CORE workflows
negative_or_hostile_proof: Production/public Django Admin and product-control substitution fail

requirement: Formatting, lint, type checking and test commands are deterministic and enforced
positive_proof: Clean checkout executes documented commands successfully
negative_or_hostile_proof: Introduced violation fails CI

requirement: Changed high-risk code has maintainable test seams and human-readable structure
positive_proof: Review confirms cohesive modules, typed contracts and decision comments
negative_or_hostile_proof: God-file growth, duplicate logic or unexplained constants fails review

requirement: Coverage and test-effectiveness gates prevent assertion-free success
positive_proof: Thresholds pass and a controlled fault is detected by relevant tests
negative_or_hostile_proof: Empty test, removed assertion or deliberate mutation surviving fails

requirement: Final exact-SHA closure is independently reproducible and fail-closed
positive_proof: Clean launcher, CI artifacts and closure audit agree with zero failed/pending rows
negative_or_hostile_proof: Dirty tree, provenance mismatch, manual PASS, missing artifact or injected defect fails
